newsitem.title: USA: Equifax holder seeks company investigation.
newsitem.headline: Equifax holder seeks company investigation.

text.p: Equifax Inc shareholder John Phillips said he has formally demanded that the company's board hold an independent investigation into allegedly questionable practices at Equifax.

Phillips' company, Aristotle Publishing Inc, filed a lawsuit in December alleging fraud and improper sales of restricted voter registration data in violation of state privacy laws at the company's CDB/Infotek unit, he said.
Atlanta-based information services firm Equifax was not immediately available to comment on the demand. Phillips was also not immediately available for comment.
The demand asked the company to determine why officers allegedly failed to detect the sale of data for illegal purposes at the time the CDB unit was acquired, he said.
It also asked the board to require officers to make full disclosure to shareholders and to government authorities, Phillips said.
He said he also demanded the board audit the use of all 2.5 billion of the unit's "public records" to insure its data offerings were in compliance with all applicable laws.
